phases.name: Foundation: workspace, proto, core, auth primitives

steps.name: Convert to 5-crate Cargo workspace
criteria: `cargo deny check` passes with embyr-core IO-prohibition rule
All five crates appear in `cargo metadata --workspace`
steps.implementation_notes: Convert minimal single-crate Cargo.toml to workspace root with five member crates under crates/. Pin workspace deps for tokio, tonic, axum, sqlx, argon2, blake3, thiserror, serde, tracing.

steps.name: Vendor Firestore protos and run tonic-build codegen
steps.implementation_notes: Vendor googleapis Firestore v1 protos into proto/. Configure tonic-build in build.rs. Also define embyr.agent.v1 StorageAgent service proto.

steps.name: Define core domain types and BackendAdapter trait
criteria: `cargo deny check` confirms embyr-core has no IO crate in dependency closure
steps.implementation_notes: Pure Rust domain: Project, ProjectStatus, BackendMode, BackendConfig, FirestoreDocument, FieldValue (8 types), QueryFilter, TransactionId. BackendAdapter trait: get/create/update/delete document, run_query, begin/commit/rollback transaction, probe.

steps.name: Auth primitives: Argon2id, BLAKE3, ECIES (pure fns)
criteria: Argon2id hash of known key verifies correctly (unit test)
ECIES encrypt-then-decrypt round-trips a DSN string
`cargo test -p embyr-core` passes all auth unit tests
steps.implementation_notes: Argon2id: memory=65536KiB, iter=3, par=4, dual-hash rotation window. ECIES: x25519-dalek + hkdf + aes-gcm, private key re-derived from API key on each call. BLAKE3: cache key derivation. All pure/no-async.

phases.name: Walking skeleton: system DB, customer DB, gRPC GetDocument

steps.name: System DB schema and SystemDb adapter
criteria: sqlx migrate run against Testcontainers Postgres succeeds
SystemDb::probe() returns Ok when DB reachable and schema current
SystemDb::probe() returns Err with structured message when unreachable
steps.implementation_notes: System DB tables: projects, daily_project_metrics, composite_indexes. SystemDb adapter uses sqlx compile-time checked queries. probe() verifies schema version.

steps.name: Customer DB schema and PostgresBackendAdapter::probe + get_document
criteria: PostgresBackendAdapter::probe() passes against Testcontainers Postgres with migrations
get_document returns Ok(None) for non-existent path
get_document returns Ok(Some(doc)) for seeded document with correct fields
steps.implementation_notes: Customer DB: documents table (project_id, collection_path, document_id, fields JSONB, version BIGINT, create_time, update_time, deleted). Implements BackendAdapter trait.

steps.name: Walking skeleton: gRPC server wiring and GetDocument E2E
criteria: Walking skeleton test passes: document seeded in Postgres, GetDocument via tonic returns doc with exists=true
Server refuses to start when SystemDb probe fails
Auth interceptor rejects wrong API key with UNAUTHENTICATED
steps.implementation_notes: Composition root: wire → probe_all → listen. Auth interceptor Tower layer: load project, check status, Argon2id verify via spawn_blocking, rate limit, resolve BackendAdapter from CredentialCache. Wire gRPC listener on ephemeral port for tests.

steps.name: Healthz endpoint and US-01 SDK configure tests
criteria: gRPC client pointed at non-existent host gets transport error (not panic)
All three us_01 acceptance tests pass

phases.name: Document write, read, delete, and full field type encoding

steps.name: CreateDocument, UpdateDocument, delete with OCC
steps.implementation_notes: CreateDocument: INSERT version=1, server-assigned microsecond timestamps. UpdateDocument: UPDATE with OCC version check, ABORTED on mismatch. delete_document: soft-delete via deleted=true.

steps.name: All 8 Firestore field types round-trip encoding
steps.implementation_notes: Encode/decode: string, int64, float64, bool, Timestamp (ns precision), bytes, array (recursive), map (recursive), null. JSONB storage format per type. MissingDocument response for absent paths.

phases.name: RunQuery: basic and advanced (NaN, indexes, collection groups)

steps.name: RunQuery: where, orderBy, limit, startAfter
steps.implementation_notes: Translate StructuredQuery to dynamic SQL via sqlx. FieldFilter: JSONB path extract + cast. CompositeFilter: AND. OrderBy: ORDER BY JSONB cast. Limit: LIMIT N. StartAfter: WHERE clause from cursor snapshot. Stream DocumentResult then Done.

steps.name: Advanced query: NaN, composite indexes, collection groups
steps.implementation_notes: IS_NAN: JSONB NaN detection. Composite index: composite_indexes table in system DB; FAILED_PRECONDITION when no READY index for multi-field+orderBy query. Collection group: all_descendants=true omits collection_path prefix constraint in SQL.

phases.name: Real-time Listen: initial snapshot, NOTIFY fan-out, resume tokens

steps.name: Listen initial snapshot: AddTarget, DocumentChange, CURRENT
steps.implementation_notes: Listen bidi streaming RPC. AddTarget: query documents, stream DocumentChange(Added) per doc, then TargetChange(CURRENT). ListenRegistry: Arc<RwLock<HashMap<ProjectId, Vec<SubscriberTx>>>>. Keep-alive: NO_CHANGE every 30s. Slow consumer overflow: RESET on channel capacity 64 exceeded. NOTIFY channel name: dc_<BLAKE3_16hex(project_id)> (19 chars, safe for Postgres 63-char limit — resolves OQ-04).

steps.name: Postgres LISTEN/NOTIFY fan-out for live updates
steps.implementation_notes: PostgresNotifyListener: dedicated PgConnection (not pool) per project, LISTEN dc_<BLAKE3_16hex>. After write commit: NOTIFY dc_<channel> with document path. Per-project Tokio task receives NOTIFY, calls get_document (handles 8KB cap), calls ListenRegistry::fan_out. In-process query filter per subscriber target.

steps.name: Resume token: delta delivery and stale token re-snapshot
criteria: reconnect_with_resume_token_delivers_only_delta passes (3 delta events, no full re-snapshot)
steps.implementation_notes: Resume token: BLAKE3(timestamp + project_id) bytes. On reconnect with token <= 24h old: query update_time > decoded_ts (delta). Token > 24h or unknown: full re-snapshot (no error). Emit NO_CHANGE with fresh token after CURRENT and each keep-alive.

phases.name: Transactions: BeginTransaction, Commit, Rollback, OCC expiry

steps.name: Full transaction lifecycle with OCC and auto-expiry
steps.implementation_notes: Transactions table in customer DB: transaction_id (UUID), read_set (paths+versions), write_set (pending mutations), status, started_at. OCC at Commit: verify each read_set doc version unchanged; ABORTED if mismatch. Auto-expiry Tokio task: mark expired after 60s; Commit of expired → NOT_FOUND.

phases.name: Admin API: provisioning, monitoring, and project lifecycle

steps.name: POST /admin/v1/projects direct_pg provisioning
steps.implementation_notes: AdminRouter: axum on separate TcpListener :9090. Admin auth: Bearer token constant-time comparison vs EMBYR_ADMIN_KEY. Provision: validate project_id regex, check dup, probe DSN, ECIES-encrypt DSN, Argon2id-hash API key (spawn_blocking), apply customer migrations, return 201 with one-time api_key.

steps.name: GET /admin/v1/projects and daily_project_metrics
steps.implementation_notes: GET returns status, backend_mode, auth_mode; no raw creds or encrypted bytes. MetricsAdapter: upsert daily_project_metrics after every SDK request via ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE ADD. Wire MetricsPort into auth interceptor post-request path.

steps.name: Suspend, activate, delete with cache invalidation
steps.implementation_notes: Suspend: update status to SUSPENDED + evict from CredentialCache immediately. Auth interceptor checks status on each cache miss. Delete: soft-delete (status=deleted, deleted_at=now()); GET returns 404 immediately. Deletion sweeper Tokio task purges after deletion_retention (168h).

phases.name: Browser transport: gRPC-Web and BrowserChannel on :8081

steps.name: gRPC-Web and BrowserChannel REST port implementation
steps.implementation_notes: RestRouter: axum :8081 with tonic-web layer for gRPC-Web (Content-Type grpc-web+proto reframing). BrowserChannel: POST /channel creates session+SID, GET /channel back-channel long-polls events. BrowserChannelSession: in-process Arc<Mutex<HashMap<SID, SessionState>>>. Resolves OQ-02 (CORS) and OQ-03 (undocumented extensions) by conforming to Firebase JS SDK behavior.

phases.name: Agent backend: embyr-agent binary and AgentBackendAdapter

steps.name: embyr-agent binary with mTLS StorageAgent gRPC
steps.implementation_notes: Agent startup: read EMBYR_AGENT_DB_DSN, EMBYR_AGENT_CERT, EMBYR_AGENT_KEY, EMBYR_AGENT_CA; exit non-zero with clear error if any missing. Probe Postgres. Start tonic mTLS gRPC server (rustls, require client cert from CA). Implement StorageAgentServer proxying BackendAdapter methods. Static link on Linux musl.

steps.name: AgentBackendAdapter in embyr-server for agent provisioning
steps.implementation_notes: AgentBackendAdapter: tonic mTLS channel to agent_endpoint. Implements BackendAdapter by proxying each method over StorageAgent gRPC. probe() calls lightweight ping RPC. Store only backend_agent_endpoint in system DB; backend_pg_creds_enc = NULL.

phases.name: Cloud secrets: AWS Secrets Manager and GCP Secret Manager

steps.name: AwsSecretFetcher adapter with LocalStack integration
steps.implementation_notes: AwsSecretFetcher: aws-sdk-secretsmanager GetSecretValue. Parse JSON {dsn:...}. Cache DSN with 5min TTL in CredentialCache. probe() calls GetSecretValue at startup. AccessDeniedException → backend_secret_fetch_failed. Malformed JSON → backend_secret_format_invalid. LocalStack ENDPOINT_URL in test env.

steps.name: GcpSecretFetcher adapter with GCP emulator integration
criteria: gcp_access_secret_version_is_audited passes (emulator call log shows AccessSecretVersion)
steps.implementation_notes: GcpSecretFetcher: google-cloud-secretmanager AccessSecretVersion (OQ-01: if crate unstable, fall back to reqwest + GCP auth token). 5min TTL cache. Store only backend_secret_gcp resource name. Mirrors AwsSecretFetcher error mapping.

phases.name: Rate limiting: per-project per-instance token bucket

steps.name: Per-project token bucket rate limiter in auth middleware
steps.implementation_notes: RateLimiter: in-process HashMap<ProjectId, TokenBucket> behind Arc<Mutex<T>>. TokenBucket: capacity=default_burst, refill_rate=default_rps tokens/sec, last_refill timestamp. check_and_consume in auth Tower layer after credential verification. ratelimit.enabled=false: skip check. Per-project isolation: independent buckets.
